Chapter 937: Chapter 4 Unprecedented (Subscribe Request)

Chapter 937: Chapter 4 Unprecedented (Subscribe Request)

After uploading the Eleventh Level, Martial Tao is the level eleven evolutionary pathway.

It is also the highest level in the ultimate evolutionary pathways.

“The latest ranking of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway…”

Lin Yuan immediately looked at the ‘Martial Tao’ section in his personal information.

As the founder of Martial Tao, Lin Yuan has the authority to see the latest rankings of Martial Tao.

As for others, they must wait until the evolution rankings ‘update’ at midnight to see them.

“This is…”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

Even after uploading the Eleventh Level, Lin Yuan had anticipated the rankings of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway.

That was still tenth.

After all, the nine evolutionary pathways ahead are all ultimate evolutionary pathways.

The potential of the Martial Tao Eleventh Level, no matter how great, is ultimately not an ultimate evolutionary pathway, and cannot be compared with the ultimate evolutionary pathways.

However—

When Lin Yuan saw the latest ranking of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway, he couldn’t help but feel surprised.

“Martial Tao evolutionary pathway… fifth in the human civilization evolution rankings!”

“Fifth?” Lin Yuan was inevitably surprised.

Although it only rose four ranks, from tenth to fifth.

But it’s important to realize, the pathways Martial Tao surpassed are all ultimate evolutionary pathways.

“It seems the three Goddesses’ ranking algorithm for evolutionary pathways does not weigh ultimate evolutionary pathways very heavily,” Lin Yuan concluded.

If considering potential alone, the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway is definitely not an ultimate evolutionary pathway.

After all, despite the high potential of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway, it only has the potential to ascend to an ultimate evolutionary pathway, but ultimate evolutionary pathways are already ultimate by nature.

Therefore.

The fact that the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway reached fifth in human civilization must be influenced by other factors.

“It must be the spatiotemporal fusion rule model.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the spatiotemporal fusion rule model from the First to Fifth Realm directly reduced the training difficulty for eleventh level human civilization evolvers by several tiers.

This influence is probably even greater than that of ultimate evolutionary pathways.

“And that’s a good thing.”

Lin Yuan determined in his heart.

Since the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway has become the fifth evolutionary pathway in human civilization, it will definitely cause a significant surge in the number of Martial Arts Evolutionaries.

This is also helpful for Lin Yuan’s future pursuit of the ultimate path.

Although after his journey to the Immortal Realm, the number of Martial Tao practitioners has already surpassed the combined number of practitioners from the nine great ultimate evolutionary pathways.

But Lin Yuan certainly wouldn’t mind having more Martial Tao practitioners.

“Continue cultivating.”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan continued to delve into comprehension.

Upon returning to the Main Universe, Lin Yuan faintly perceived the possibility of advancing again within the Seventh Realm of Space-Time.

Of course, not from the Seventh to the Eighth Realm, as with Lin Yuan’s level of life, reaching the Seventh Realm of Space-Time is already the limit.

What about the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time? Even if it could be comprehended, it would be blown apart in an instant by the vast information of spatiotemporal fusion rules.

But at least it could take another step within the Seventh Realm, like reaching the mid-stage of the Seventh Realm?

…

The next day at dawn.

Several evolutionary pathway rankings in the Virtual World began to ‘update’ sequentially.

“Martial Tao, Martial Tao evolutionary pathway…”

“What’s up with the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway? Did they update the Eleventh Tier?”

“Actually, whether Martial Tao updates the Eleventh Rank doesn’t really affect us, as the rankings won’t change, and we don’t know the specific potential of the Eleventh Rank…”

In the Virtual World, many evolvers and high-level citizens initially didn’t take it seriously.

When the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway updated the Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank, the rankings rose significantly, sparking their curiosity, prompting them to purchase the latest chapters of Martial Tao to explore.

But now?

The Martial Tao evolutionary pathway is already the tenth pathway in human civilization, with only the ultimate evolutionary pathways above it. The gap is too big.

Even if the Eleventh Rank of Martial Tao is exceptionally outstanding, could it really surpass the ultimate evolutionary pathways?

“Fifth, the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway has become the fifth evolutionary pathway in human civilization.”

“What? Could it be that the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway continuously updated the Eleventh Rank, Twelfth Rank?”

“Wrong, the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway only updated the Eleventh Rank.”

“Just updating the Eleventh Rank, and it’s ranked fifth in human civilization’s evolutionary pathways? Surpassing four major ultimate evolutionary pathways?”

…

Countless high-ranking citizens of human civilization were dumbstruck.

In their understanding, the nine ultimate beings reigned supreme above all, and the corresponding nine ultimate evolutionary paths were the same.

Even the most brilliant genius and the most astonishing evolutionary path cannot compare to these nine ultimate evolutionary paths, unless they too could join the ranks of the ultimate evolutionary paths.

“Impossible, the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path indeed has great potential and may become an ultimate evolutionary path, but how could it surpass the ultimate evolutionary paths?”

“Right, aspiring to become an ultimate evolutionary path is ultimately not the same as being an ultimate evolutionary path.”

The Eleventh Level Evolvers of human civilization were also shaken, even those hidden eleventh-level evolvers from before the Starry Sea Era, who had never revealed themselves to alien races, found it unbelievable.

The Eleventh Level Evolutionary Path surpasses the four great ultimate evolutionary paths to become the fifth evolutionary path of human civilization?

“Could the three Goddesses have made a mistake?”

“The three Goddesses making a mistake? The changes in the ranking of ultimate evolutionary paths cannot be decided by the three Goddesses alone, the nine ultimate beings must have already been aware.”

“Martial Arts Evolutionary Path being ranked fifth must be recognized by the nine ultimate beings.”

…

After a brief moment of incredulity, those ancient eleventh-level evolvers of human civilization instantly calmed down.

Doubting that the three Goddesses made a mistake is unrealistic; even if the three Goddesses were wrong, could it be that the nine ultimate beings of human civilization were also mistaken?

Since so much time has passed and the ranking of the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path remains unchanged, it means there are no mistakes or errors in this matter.

“Since the ultimate beings all know and still keep the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path at fifth, there must be some highly impactful information contained in the Eleventh Rank Chapter?”

“I’m going to buy the Eleventh Rank Chapter now to see.”

“Me too.”

…

The eleventh-level evolvers of human civilization immediately started purchasing, too curious about the mysterious profoundness contained within the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path, which has made it the fifth evolutionary path of human civilization.

“Is this a rule model?”

“So many pillar-level fusion rules’ models?”

“And the rule model of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?”

“No wonder no wonder?”

The many eleventh level evolvers, who initially bought the Martial Tao Eleventh Rank Chapter with many emotions, immediately went silent and began to fervently comprehend it.

Many pillar-level fusion rule models and the rule model of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, akin to a path to the heavens, even those eleventh level perfected evolvers who have reached the Fifth Realm in spatiotemporal comprehension, were greatly moved and immediately began their closed-door training.

…

Virtual World, a certain Mysterious Space.

Nine ultimate beings of human civilization sat on their thrones.

“Allowing the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path to join the fifth rank, none of you four have objections, right?” Xuanyuan Supreme looked at four of the ultimate beings and calmly said.

The Goddess of Wisdom specifically asked him whether to determine the corresponding ranking based on the final merit points, considering the dignity of the ultimate beings.

Allowing the Eleventh Level Martial Arts Evolutionary Path to surpass the four great ultimate evolutionary paths might cause emotional responses in the corresponding four ultimate beings.

“Any objections.”

The four ultimate beings shook their heads: “The contribution and impact of the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter on human civilization are indeed greater than that of a single ultimate evolutionary path.”

Being able to step into the twelfth level, they naturally have precise judgments about the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path.

The ranking of human civilization evolution only considers the impact of the evolutionary path itself, and the Martial Arts Evolutionary Path Eleventh Rank Chapter will have a profound impact on all the evolvers of human civilization.

This aspect is something that some ultimate evolutionary paths cannot compare to.

“But be careful of other alien races.”

The Void God Ultimate Being suddenly said, the many rule models contained in the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter are of great help to any evolving being: just as much for human civilization evolvers as for those Alien Strong Ones.

“Don’t worry, I’ve already reinforced the distribution channels through the Clan Suppression Weapon several times.”

Xuanyuan Supreme nodded and said.

To purchase the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter, to obtain the many rule models inside, one can only do so through the official Virtual World of human civilization.

Xuanyuan Supreme has already reinforced this purchasing channel several times and it will not leak.

As for after the purchase, whether it can be spread by oneself? Even after thoroughly understanding all the rule models in the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter, it’s not possible to spread it out.

Understanding is one thing, communicating and spreading it is another.

Just like the nine ultimate beings of human civilization, all have the comprehension of the Sixth Realm in space-time, but they cannot perfectly complete the rule models from the First to the Ninth Realm of space-time.

Unless one can reach the level of Lin Yuan in rule comprehension, even if one watches all the rule models, they cannot talk about it, at most they can only know it themselves.

Therefore…

The only way for other alien races to obtain the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter is to blend into human civilization, disguised as human evolutioners, and buy it in the official Virtual World.

But the risk is too high, the Virtual World of human civilization is extremely strict in screening alien identities; out of a hundred alien spies infiltrating, probably not even one can survive the initial screening.

Those infiltrated alien spy assassins are essentially ‘dead men’, already prepared to be discovered by human civilization at any moment, resulting in their cloned originals all dying and falling.

The Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter is most useful to eleventh level beings, but an eleventh level alien infiltrating human civilization? Each eleventh level in human civilization is numbered and watched by the ultimate beings, and it’s impossible for a new eleventh level to sneak in unnoticed.

As for those exceptional geniuses from other races? Alien races would not allow their geniuses to risk their cloned originals dying to infiltrate human civilization to obtain the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter.

“The opening and completion of the Martial Arts Eleventh Rank Chapter indicates that the Galaxy Master is not far from reaching the twelfth level,” Xuanyuan Supreme said with expectation and a smile.
